style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D): a cave spider with a dark body, red markings and eight thin legs, a clean dark outline, chunky readable pixels, gentle highlights and shading. Match the character, colours and proportions of the reference image exactly. Side view, the creature facing right. Draw only the creature: no ground, no thread, no rope, no shadow, no effects.

frames.name: hang_1
frames.prompt: The same spider hanging from above, legs drawn in close to a compact body, waiting. Do not draw the thread.

frames.name: hang_2
frames.prompt: The same spider hanging, legs twitching slightly wider, ready to drop. Do not draw the thread.

frames.name: drop
frames.prompt: The same spider dropping: legs flung wide and up, body falling, fangs out.

frames.name: crawl_1
frames.prompt: The same spider crawling right: front legs reaching forward, body low.

frames.name: crawl_2
frames.prompt: The same spider crawling: legs gathered under the body.

frames.name: crawl_3
frames.prompt: The same spider crawling: rear legs pushing, front legs reaching again.

frames.name: crawl_4

frames.name: stunned

frames.name: downed
